scripts.check: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/config.js && node --check server/rules.js && node --check public/customer.js && node --check public/agent.js && node --check scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/widget && npm install --prefix apps/workstation
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --prefix apps/widget && npm run build --prefix apps/workstation
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,widget,workstation -c green,magenta,cyan "node --watch server/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix apps/widget" "npm run dev --prefix apps/workstation"
